chunks: The people of Noah, Ar-Rass, and Thamud denied before you.

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ الرَّسِ: The people of Hud (associated with the location Rass)

ai.seo_question: Which tribes denied their prophets before the people of Mecca?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the continuity of divine testing, noting that the rejection of prophets is a recurring historical pattern rather than an isolated incident. The mention of 'As-hab al-Ras' (People of the Well), often identified with the tribe of Thamud or a distinct group, underscores the specific locale of their trial, while the inclusion of Noah and Thamud serves as a comprehensive reminder of both ancient and recent precedents of disbelief. This reinforces the concept of 'Tawatur' in prophetic history, where the fate of the disbelievers is consistent across different eras.
